packageRules.description: Electron ships Chromium security fixes almost weekly – update as soon as they are out. It is a devDependency but ships inside the app, so its updates are fix(deps) and trigger a release-please patch release.
Keep electron-builder and its sub-packages in one PR
Automerge non-major updates of dev tooling and actions once CI is green

All minor and patch updates (Rust crates, npm, GitHub Actions) in one weekly PR. Electron stays out: it ships Chromium security fixes and keeps its own fast PR. Not automerged because it contains crates that ship in the app; fix(deps) so release-please cuts a patch release.
Node in CI (.nvmrc) and engines must match the Node bundled with Electron – no automatic major bumps
engines.node is a minimum, not a pin – only change it when a new version falls outside the range
